scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:php
scripts.check:format: npm run check:format:js && npm run check:format:php
scripts.lint:php: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/app" -w /app php:8.3-cli -d memory_limit=-1 vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --configuration=phpstan.neon --no-progress --memory-limit=4G
scripts.check:lint:php: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/app" -w /app php:8.3-cli -d memory_limit=-1 vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --configuration=phpstan.neon --no-progress --memory-limit=4G --error-format=table
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:php
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:php
